definitions: A word, clause, or sentence inserted as an explanation or afterthought into a passage with which it is not syntactically related.
A pair of round brackets ( ) used to include extra information in a text or to enclose a mathematical expression.
An interval or a period of time that interrupts the normal course of something.
examples: The explanation was given in parenthesis.
Use parentheses for the optional information.
His brief career was a parenthesis in a long life of study.
